defs.def: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with sb 协定；协议；契约

ex.s: Despite various debates, there’s no agreement on what it means to be morally good.
ex.t: 当你根据听众的兴趣调整沟通方式时，他们自然会更加投入和感兴趣。___37___这将激发他们理解和互动信息的欲望。

ex.s: Bring your completed Volunteer Agreement Form.
ex.t: 请携带填写完整的志愿者协议表。

ex.s: in terms ofD. in agreement with
The lack of agreement among ALifers doesn’t help either.
ex.t: ALife研究者之间的缺乏共识也无济于事。

ex.s: In 1793, Britain's King George III sent Lord George Macartney and other trade ambassadors to China to  ___33___ a trade agreement.
ex.t: 他说那是他们为自己的国王所需要做的全部。

ex.s: It is not surprising, then, that Macartney left China without negotiating the trade agreement.
ex.t: 另一个通过两国之间______而产生的借词是"工合"。

defs.def: the state of sharing the same opinion or feeling （意见或看法）一致

ex.s: In 1959, an agreement was signed by twelve countries, and since then many more countries have joined.
ex.t: 1959年， 12个国家签署了一项协议，此后又有更多国家加入。

ex.s: To give an example, I will be signing an organ donation agreement this time tomorrow.
ex.t: 举个例子，我明天这个时候将签署一份器官捐赠协议。

ex.s: Future continuous a … I will be signing an organ donation agreement this time tomorrow.
ex.t: FUTURE CONTINUENT a…我明天这个时候将签署一份器官捐赠协议。

ex.s: Subject-verb agreement (1) a Your enemy is well trained, well equipped and battle-hardened...
ex.t: 主语-动词一致(1) a您的敌人训练有素、装备精良、战斗力强……

ex.s: Now look for more sentences following this rule in the reading passage, and summarise the use of subject-verb agreement in your own words.
ex.t: 现在，在阅读段落中寻找更多遵循这条规则的句子，并用你自己的话总结主动词一致性的使用。
